(Currently amended) Claim 1: A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is defined by properties including flexibility and adaptability to maintain a seal.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, and wherein the tapered portion exhibits an angle of less than 40 degrees.

(Currently amended) Claim 7: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, the tapered portion being defined by an angle that promotes effective sealing against said tapered fluid conduit.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, a polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, wherein at least one of the materials is selected for its ability to provide a durable sealing capability under high pressure conditions.

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, the seal retainer being configured to assist in maintaining the alignment of the compliant seal during use. 

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, while retaining its sealing effectiveness over a longevity of operational cycles.
